book.name: Vatomwe
book.title: Jisas Krais Le Vatomwe Weya Jon

content: Nyao thovuye theghelimaninji i uwiya le mema
Amba nyao thovuye theghelimaninjima i uwiya le mema, na ya thuweya ghɨtarama iya me dobuma e buruburuko na i unja e yambaneke. Na i thɨn giyawa ki, goga iya i ghenenja moli ghaki.

Mbaŋa ghɨtarama i vugha gogako umbaliye, mundu laghɨye ŋgoreiya ndɨghe laghɨye munduwae i raŋgima e tɨneko. Gogako iya i ghenenja moli iyako munduwae i poku laghɨye moli na i rogana varaeko marae mbouye.
Kaero bibita thɨ raka raŋgima e munduko tɨne thɨ rakanja e yambaneke, Loi i giya vurɨgheghe weŋgi ŋgoreiya thegheghɨyama e yambaneke lenji vurɨgheghe.
Va i dageten weŋgi na thava thɨ vakowana nana, o umbwa, o bigi i mbuthumbuthu, mbe iyaeŋge vara gharɨgharɨ ma Loi le nono na e ghamwanji thɨ vakowanaŋgi.

Loi mava i vatomwe weŋgi na thɨ rɨrɨvavamareŋgi, ko iyemaeŋge mbe thɨ vakathaeŋge vɨrɨ weŋgi mbaŋa le molamolao ŋgoreiya manjala umbolima. Lenji vakathako ŋgoreiya thetheghɨyama i vodɨgha lolo na le vɨrɨvɨrɨ.
E mbaŋaŋgiko thiyako tɨnenji gharɨgharɨko thiyako ne vɨrɨko kaiwae na thɨ tamwetamweya mare, ko iyemaeŋge othembe ne nuwanjiko nuwaiya thɨ mare, mare ne i voiteteŋgi.

Bibitako thiyako ŋgoranjiya hos kaero thɨ vivathaŋgi gaithɨ kaiwae. E umbalinji bigi regha ŋgoreiya umbalinji ghamatabwaya thɨ vakatha gol na thɨ bigirawe e umbalinji, ghamwanji ghayamoyamo ŋgoreiya gharɨgharɨ ghamwaghamwanji.
Umbalinji vulivuliye ŋgoreiya wanakau umbalinji vulivuliye na ŋiŋinji ŋgoreiya laiyon ŋiŋiye.
Gharenji vwatae e kunakunauye ŋgoreiya gharenji vwatae ghaghetagagana thɨ vakatha e aiyan, na vineinji laiye ŋgoreiya hos thɨ rukuliya sariyot lemoyo gaithɨ kaiwae.
Wolounji ŋgoreiya thetheghɨya na mbe thɨ vovodɨweva, e wolounjiko thɨ vodɨŋgiya gharɨgharɨwe le vurɨgheghe i vakatha vɨrɨ iya i wo manjala umbolima.
E lenji kiŋ, i mbaroŋaŋgi. Iye gogama iya i ghenenja molima ghanyao raitharɨ. Idae vaŋa Hibru thɨŋa Abadon, na vaŋa Grik thɨŋa Apoliyon.
Tharɨ iviva kaero iko; tharɨ theghewo amba iya thɨ menamenako.
Nyao thovuye theghewonaninji i uwiya le mema
Amba nyao thovuye ghewonaninji i uwiya le mema, kaero ya loŋweya ghalɨghalɨŋa regha i mena e ghamba vowo gol mbothiye ghevarɨ weŋgi, iya i yaku Loi e ghamwaeko.
I dage weya nyaoko thovuye iya ghewonaninjiko ele memako iŋa, “U rakayathuŋgiya nyao thovuthovuye theghevarɨ, iya thɨ ŋgarɨŋgina na thiya yaku e Walaghɨta Yupreitis.”

Kaero i rakayathuŋgiya nyaoma thovuthovuye theghevarɨ na vethɨ tagavamareŋgiya gharɨgharɨ e yambaneke lenji ghanaghanagha ŋgoreiya wan ted (1/3). Loi va i laweghathɨŋgi ghaghad lughawoghawoke iyake, mbaŋake iyake, manjalake iyake na theghatheghake iyake.
Lenji ragagaithɨ thɨ rakatha e hos vwatae, methɨ giya yanawaŋgu lenji ghanaghanagha i wo tu handred miliyon.

E wovatomweko tɨne ya thuweya hos na gharathatha ghanjiyamoyamo ŋgoreiyake: Gharenji vwatae e ghaghetagagana, ghanjiyamoyamo thɨ soro ŋgoreiye ndɨghe mamiye, thɨ blu ŋgoreiye varɨ idae sapaya na thɨ mbwaumbwau ŋgoreiya salp. Hosɨko umbalinji ghayamoyamo ŋgoreiya laiyon umbalinji, na ndɨghe, mundu na varɨ salp i rara i raŋgima e ghaenji.
Thɨvatharɨ i mena e ndɨghe, mundu na varɨ salpa thɨ raŋgima hosɨko e ghaenji; iya theghetoke iyake thɨ gaboŋgiya yambaneke gharɨgharɨniye valɨvaŋga ŋgoreiya wan ted (1/3) na thiya mare.
Hosɨko lenji vurɨgheghe i mena e ghaenji na e wolounji. Kaiwae wolounjiko ŋgoreiya mwata e umbaumbalinji na iyake thɨ giya vɨrɨ weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ.

Ko iyemaeŋge gharɨgharɨ iya tharɨko theghetoko iyako mava i gaboŋgi na thiya mare, mava thɨ goru weya iyako, bigibigi vatavatadɨŋgi ma thɨ ndeghereiye wanaŋgi. Mbe thɨ kurukururu weŋgiya nyao raraitharɨ na bigibigi vatavatadɨŋgi e gol, silva, kopa, varɨ na umbwa. Bigibigiko thiyako ma valɨkaiwanji thɨ thuwe, ma valɨkaiwanji thɨ loŋwe, ma valɨkaiwanji thɨ loŋga.
Tembe ŋgoreiyeva, gharɨgharɨko thiyako lenji gabo, lenji kukura na rɨmbɨre, lenji yathima thanavuniye, na lenji kaivɨ ma thɨ ndeghereiye wanaŋgi.
